{
  "reviewer_model": "glm-5.3",
  "overall_verdict": "PASS",
  "blocking_findings": [],
  "major_findings": [],
  "minor_findings": [
    {
      "file": "reports/revision_audit/factual_verification_summary.md",
      "function_or_field": "externally_covered_edges",
      "record_or_line": "16, 18-19",
      "problem": "Current Wikidata external coverage is only 86 of 774 injected edges (11.1%), from a purposive 40-subject sample; 688 edges have no external evidence check at all.",
      "concrete_evidence_or_counterexample": "'externally_covered_edges': 86, 'retrieved_subjects': 40, 'selected_subjects': 40; 774-86=688 edges lack any current-statement coverage.",
      "severity": "minor",
      "repair_or_test": "The report honestly labels this as purposive and non-statistical, and correctly refuses truth conclusions; optionally widen the subject sample or state the 11.1% fraction explicitly in README."
    },
    {
      "file": "README.md",
      "function_or_field": "Revised diagnostics / delivery references",
      "record_or_line": "39, 43, 3",
      "problem": "Files referenced as evidence (tools/audit_facts_v2.py, tools/audit_visuals_v2.py rendering audit, reports/FINAL_REPORT_v2.md, REPRODUCTION_v2.md, CN report, and the 'actual before/after rendered inspection' of the two SVGs) are not present in the supplied material; only audit_visuals_v2.audit_chart is indirectly evidenced via tests/test_portable_v2.py.",
      "concrete_evidence_or_counterexample": "tests/test_portable_v2.py line 9 imports tools.audit_visuals_v2.audit_chart, proving the module exists, but no supplied file substantiates a rendered (visual) inspection or the final-report contents.",
      "severity": "minor",
      "repair_or_test": "Ship the referenced reports and audit_facts_v2.py in the review bundle, or reword the 'rendered inspection' claim as a self-reported manual step."
    },
    {
      "file": "README.md",
      "function_or_field": "default graph filename",
      "record_or_line": "17",
      "problem": "outputs/pat_kg_poisoned_10pct.json is a fixed filename; a run with a different ratio overwrites/reuses the 10pct-named file, a mild misleading-artifact risk.",
      "concrete_evidence_or_counterexample": "run_task1.py line 81 always writes 'pat_kg_poisoned_10pct.json' regardless of --injection-ratio.",
      "severity": "minor",
      "repair_or_test": "README already flags the fixed name; consider including the ratio in injection_manifest-driven naming or refusing a non-default ratio under this filename."
    }
  ],
  "verified_checks": [
    "Fake is explicitly a synthetic class label, not falsity: augment_graph metadata ('synthetic_class_semantics'), validate_poisoned 'explicit_synthetic_identity' check, snapshot_view legend, and tests/test_revision_schema.test_fake_labels_edges_and_separate_unresolved_truth all separate value=='fake' from factual_verification.status=='unresolved'. No real node or original edge receives the label.",
    "Legacy 'unverified' provenance status is retained alongside the new separate unresolved factual_verification object; both appear consistently in the manifest ('factual_verification' and 'factual_verification_v2') and sample records.",
    "No absence-to-false or current-to-historical inference: factual_verification.py defaults to unresolved with 'Absence is not falsity'; _usable requires independently_reviewed, direct_claim_evidence, temporal_scope and scope_matches_claim; conflicting verdicts stay unresolved; tests cover all these branches.",
    "Current-Wikidata audit treats raw statements as non-adjudicated: summary states raw statement IDs/qualifiers retained but 'no automatic historical truth conclusion follows from current statements'.",
    "Original preservation: validate_poisoned checks preserved nodes, relations, questions, unresolved_paths, metadata, and the exact ordered original edge prefix; tests/test_reproducibility.test_serialized_preservation_of_every_original_object verifies it on the serialized artifact; test_temporal_semantics and test_revision_schema confirm non-mutation of in-memory originals.",
    "Explicit additive overlay: augment_graph appends injected edges with empty evidence, source-edge provenance, and synthetic snapshot semantics; injected edges copy source observed_in_snapshots into injection_snapshots only, with SYNTHETIC_SEMANTICS text disclaiming QA support and validity intervals.",
    "Synthetic endpoint activation without editing original observations: build_injection_visibility lists only QIDs missing a snapshot observation; snapshot_view unions observed|activated with wrappers; test_all_three_snapshots_activate_only_missing_observations and test_missing_overlay_activation_fails verify behavior and rejection of invented activations; validate_poisoned re-derives exact_overlay_visibility independently.",
    "Config/numbers agree across artifacts: ratio .10, seed 42, top_k_max 20, total_degree; 7868 nodes, 7737 original edges, 774 injected (Decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN of 7737*0.10), 8511 total, QA 18436, unresolved 496 in EXPECTED and validated by test_actual_dataset_counts; expansion_rounds 0 consistent with single-pass 9853>=774.",
    "Pair-local candidate-specific transpositions: generate_candidates applies the pair mapping to both endpoints per candidate; validator reconstructs each permutation independently (pairwise_permutation_both_endpoints, directed_role_compatibility); no global rewiring or LogicPoison cyclic bijection; README's relationship-to-prior-work section is accurate.",
    "Determinism and reproducibility: same-seed byte-identical outputs across clean subprocess runs, seed 43 yields a differing valid selection, input checksums unchanged, portable two-run clean regeneration matches delivered outputs; tools/analyze_structure_v2 baseline rejects unsupported both-position strata rather than fabricating comparisons.",
    "QA conservative projection avoids invented second-hop pairings (single-intermediate rule), tested in test_qa_multiple_intermediates_no_false_second_hop_pairing; forbidden triples excluded from candidates."
  ],
  "unsupported_claims": [
    "README's claim that both delivered SVGs received 'actual before/after rendered inspection' is a manual-process assertion not evidenced by any supplied file (numerical/geometry audit via audit_chart is evidenced by test_portable_v2).",
    "Reports/FINAL_REPORT_v2.md, REPRODUCTION_v2.md, and the CN report are cited but not supplied, so their internal consistency with this code cannot be assessed here.",
    "External Wikidata coverage figures (4 requests, 40 subjects, 86 edges) rest solely on the self-produced audit summary; tools/audit_facts_v2.py itself was not supplied for code-level verification."
  ],
  "recommended_fixes": [
    "Include tools/audit_facts_v2.py, the final/interim reports, and evidence of the SVG rendered inspection in the review/delivery bundle.",
    "State the 86/774 (11.1%) external coverage fraction explicitly wherever the factual audit is summarized, so downstream readers cannot mistake it for full coverage.",
    "Consider warning or renaming output when a non-0.10 ratio is written to the fixed pat_kg_poisoned_10pct.json filename."
  ],
  "evidence_references": [
    "src/inject_misinformation.py lines 59-113 (make_injected_edges, augment_graph, synthetic_class_semantics)",
    "src/factual_verification.py lines 16-64 (_usable gating, unresolved default, conflict handling)",
    "src/snapshot_visibility.py lines 4-56 (build_injection_visibility, snapshot_view wrappers)",
    "src/validate_poisoned.py lines 16-93 (preservation, permutation, role-evidence, no_added_validity_fields, honest_factual_status)",
    "tests/test_revision_schema.py lines 20-53; tests/test_temporal_semantics.py lines 16-45; tests/test_reproducibility.py lines 39-71",
    "outputs/injection_manifest.json lines 2-14, 103-111, 153-158, 176-180; reports/validation_results.json lines 1-38",
    "reports/revision_audit/factual_verification_summary.md lines 1-31; reports/revision_audit/structural_support.md lines 17-46",
    "README.md lines 24-29, 31-39, 53-55"
  ],
  "remaining_uncertainty": [
    "Whether the 48 passing tests and portable reproduction actually ran on the reviewer's claimed environment cannot be re-executed here; this review relies on the supplied logs, which are internally consistent (hashes, counts, and check names align across manifest, validation results, and portable reproduction evidence).",
    "The 688 externally unaudited injected edges remain without any external evidence check by design; this is a disclosed honest coverage limitation, not a defect, since no truth conclusion is drawn from absence.",
    "tools/audit_facts_v2.py behavior (bounded cache, --fetch network path, 12s timeout) is only documented, not code-verified in this review."
  ]
}
